_note: Custom instructions on benchmark routes. 'originals' are the benchmark episodes for the same route (same start and goal, checked by make_custom_episodes.py); each custom instruction reuses the route of 'base'. Landmarks taken from the Task 3 episode videos.

routes.name: A
custom: Leave the bedroom and turn left. Go into the living room and stop on the rug past the gray couch.

routes.name: B
custom: Walk along the pool to the bar and stop at the corner of the bar.

routes.name: C
custom: Cross the big hall and stop in the archway on the far side.

routes.name: D
custom: Go past the dining table, turn right into the kitchen, and stop in the pantry between the shelves.

routes.name: E
custom: Walk past the couch into the kitchen. Turn left at the doors to the outside, go down the hallway, and stop where four hallways meet.
